setup.metaDescription: Choose a topic, difficulty and session length, then practise {exam} with original questions and full explanations.
setup.title: Practise {exam}
setup.lead: Practise by topic, untimed, or choose another format below.

empty.title: No reviewed questions yet for this exam
empty.body: Questions for this exam are still being checked, so there is nothing to practise here yet. Only questions that have passed review are ever served.
empty.guide: The <link>format and scoring guide</link> is complete and sourced, and is useful now.

topic.title: Topic practice
topic.body: Untimed. Change an answer freely, then check it to see the worked explanation; a checked answer is locked.
topic.ignoredFilter: The link named a topic or skill the {exam} does not have, so no filter has been applied.

setup.contentShortfall: This format needs {requested, plural, one {# reviewed question} other {# reviewed questions}} and the bank currently holds {available} that fit it. It will open as the bank grows.

about.title: About this exam
about.formatLink: Format, timing and scoring, with sources

bank.title: Question bank
bank.coverage: {count, plural, one {reviewed question} other {reviewed questions}} across {covered} of {total} topics
bank.note: This is a starter library, not a complete course. The questions are original and AI-assisted; each was solved blind by a separate AI reviewer before publication.

form.skillNote: This session is limited to one skill. Remove the filter to choose a topic instead.
form.countsNote: Counts are reviewed questions that match every setting on this form.
form.difficultyNote: Difficulty labels are our editorial judgement, not calibrated against test-taker data. A chosen level is used on its own; it is never padded with other levels.
form.newOnlyOn: Only questions you have never been shown. A session is never topped up with ones you have seen; if too few are left, it is shorter, or cannot start.
form.newOnlyOff: {seen} of the {matching} matching questions are ones you have been shown before. Those not seen recently are chosen first, but a repeat can be included; tick this to rule repeats out.
form.shortened: Only {count, plural, one {# reviewed question matches} other {# reviewed questions match}} these settings, so this session has {length}.
form.shortenedNew: Only {count, plural, one {# new reviewed question matches} other {# new reviewed questions match}} these settings, so this session has {length}.

allSeen.title: You have been shown every question that matches
allSeen.body: There is nothing new here. Include questions you have seen, or choose a broader option below.

noMatch.title: No reviewed questions match these settings
noMatch.body: Choose a broader option below, or change the topic or difficulty.

summary.count: {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} from {scope}
summary.check: check each answer to see its worked explanation

form.nothing: Nothing to start with these settings.

errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.insufficientCounts: The reviewed bank no longer holds enough questions for this combination ({available} available, {requested} requested). Reload the page to see the current counts.
errors.insufficient: The reviewed bank no longer holds enough questions for this combination. Reload the page to see the current counts.
errors.formFallback: That session could not be started.
errors.buttonFallback: This session could not be started right now.

codes.rate-limited: You have started a lot of sessions. Please wait a moment.
codes.unknown-blueprint: That practice format does not exist.
codes.simulation-unavailable: A full simulation is not offered for this exam.
codes.insufficient-content: There are not enough reviewed questions to build this session without repeating one.
codes.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again to start practising.
codes.server-error: Something went wrong on our side.

intro.title: Practise for the {exam}
intro.lead: The real exam has {count, plural, one {one section} other {# sections}}, as the test maker publishes it:

how.title: Practise the way the exam works
how.leadCount: {count, plural, one {# reviewed {exam} question} other {# reviewed {exam} questions}}, each with a worked explanation.
how.lead: Reviewed questions, each with a worked explanation.
how.topic: Topic practice: pick topics and difficulty, untimed, with the worked explanation as soon as you check an answer.
how.timed: {count, plural, one {A timed section} other {# timed sections}} at the published pace.
how.mock: A full-length mock exam under the real rules.
how.diagnostic: A short diagnostic that shows where to start.

results.title: See exactly what needs work
results.lead: Every session ends with results you can act on.
results.accuracy: Accuracy by topic and skill, so you know what to practise next.
results.notebook: A mistake notebook and a review queue that bring back what you missed.
results.plan: A study plan built around your exam date.
results.tutor: An AI tutor for hints and deeper explanations, within a daily allowance.

paid.all: {plan}: every exam plus the AI tutor, {price} a month.
paid.vat: VAT included. Cancel any time from your account.

free.open: Your free diagnostic is still open: carry on where you left off.
free.taken: You have taken this diagnostic; its results stay in your history.
free.questions: One {count}-question diagnostic, the same for everyone.
free.fixed: One fixed diagnostic, the same for everyone.
free.every: Free for every exam, with full results and explanations.

onboarding.choiceTitle: How would you like to start?

freeTest.title: Your free {exam} diagnostic
freeTest.leadTimed: {questions, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} across {sections, plural, one {one section} other {# sections}}, about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, with full results and a worked explanation for every answer.
freeTest.leadUntimed: {questions, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} across {sections, plural, one {one section} other {# sections}}, untimed, with full results and a worked explanation for every answer.

notices.rate-limited: You have started a lot of sessions. Please wait a moment and try again.
notices.insufficient-content: There are not enough reviewed questions to build this diagnostic yet.

account.title: Create a free account to take it
account.body: The diagnostic needs an account, so your results are kept. It takes an email address and a password. Without an account you can still try the sample questions.

waiting.title: Your diagnostic is waiting
waiting.body: You have started it already. Carry on where you left off; the questions stay the same however often you come back.

taken.title: You have taken this diagnostic
taken.body: There is one free diagnostic per exam, and its results stay in your history. A plan opens every practice format for this exam, with fresh questions in every session.

preview.sameForEveryone: Everyone gets the same questions; there is one free diagnostic per exam.
preview.perPart: Each section has its own clock.
preview.perPartPauses: Each section has its own clock; leaving the page pauses it.
preview.overall: One clock runs for the whole test.
preview.overallPauses: One clock runs for the whole test; leaving the page pauses it.
preview.untimed: Untimed: take as long as you need.
preview.results: At the end you see your results by topic and the worked explanation for every question.

notReady.title: Not ready yet
notReady.body: There are not enough reviewed {exam} questions to build the diagnostic yet. The format and scoring guide is complete and useful now.
notReady.guide: Read the format and scoring guide

freeTest.footer: Want every format, with fresh questions each time? <link>See plans</link>.
